original_record.question:
A rectangle on the right is divided into 7 squares. The sides of the grey squares are all 8. What is the side of the great white square?

inventory.squares: one large white, three small white below, three equal hatched squares on right

answer_verification.method: Three gray sides totalheight24. If large white sideL, three small squares below have sideL/3, so L+L/3=24 and L18.
